description: WRITE: Create a new campaign. Default status is PAUSED (recommended — set ACTIVE only after creating ad sets and ads). For CBO, pass daily_budget or lifetime_budget at this level; for ABO leave budget off and set it on the ad set. `special_ad_categories` is required (empty array [] is fine for normal advertising).

daily_budget.description: CBO daily budget in account currency minor units (cents)

lifetime_budget.description: CBO lifetime budget in minor units

special_ad_categories.description: Required by Meta. Use [] for normal ads, or include 'HOUSING'/'EMPLOYMENT'/'CREDIT' etc. where legally required

name: create_campaign
